display_long_description:
Take the wheel and enter a city overrun by the undead in Zombie Car VR: Crush & Survive, an immersive first-person VR zombie survival and car combat game built for Meta Quest.

Drive, dodge and crush your way through relentless zombie hordes. Normal zombies can be defeated only when you hit them with enough speed, so keep moving, choose your route and use your vehicle as your weapon. Every zombie attack damages your car, while unstoppable giant zombies join the chase and turn each run into an intense fight for survival.

FEATURES
• First-person VR driving with an interactive steering wheel
• Fast arcade action backed by realistic vehicle handling and driving physics
• Endless zombie survival gameplay with escalating horde size and difficulty
• Vehicle combat: ram, hit and crush zombies to earn kills
• Giant zombie encounters that force you to escape instead of attack
• Immersive urban streets made for high-speed driving, sharp turns and evasive action
• In-car HUD for health, time, current kills and best-kill high score
• Quick restart and road recovery controls to get you back into the action 

How long can you survive the zombie apocalypse? 

Test your reflexes, master the car, outrun the undead and beat your personal record. If you enjoy zombie games, survival horror, VR driving simulators, car games, action games, arcade racing, vehicle combat and high-score challenges, your next ride starts here.
